name: What permits are required for a room addition in Oakland?

mainEntity.name: What permits are required for a room addition in Oakland?

acceptedAnswer.text: In Oakland, room additions typically require a building permit from the City of Oakland Planning and Building Department. Depending on the specifics of your project, you might also need separate permits for electrical, plumbing, and mechanical work. Additionally, if the addition impacts setback requirements, lot coverage, or height limits, zoning review and possibly design review permits may be necessary. It's crucial to consult with a contractor or the city to understand all applicable permit requirements for your specific project.
acceptedAnswer.description: In Oakland, you'll need a building permit and potentially electrical, plumbing, and mechanical permits, along with zoning and design review if applicable.
